user.title: VW CarNet Login
user.description: VW CarNet integration coming soon. Click Submit to continue with manual device tracker selection.

vehicle.title: Select Vehicle
vehicle.description: Choose the device tracker entity that provides your car's GPS location.

abort.already_configured: ASP Parking Monitor is already configured.

data_description.movement_threshold: Min distance the car must move before re-running the schedule lookup.
data_description.refresh_interval: Re-check schedule even without movement so upcoming windows stay current.
data_description.stale_timeout: Mark sensor unavailable after this long without a GPS update.
data_description.notify_service: Pick a notify entity. Leave empty to disable push notifications.
data_description.notify_lead_time: How many minutes before a cleaning window starts to send the push notification.

data_description.debug_enabled: Master toggle. When off, all override fields are ignored even if set.
data_description.debug_lat: Fake GPS latitude for testing. Both lat and lon must be set together.
data_description.debug_lon: Fake GPS longitude for testing. Both lat and lon must be set together.
data_description.debug_datetime: Replace the current date/time for schedule and suspension checks.
data_description.suppress_notifications: Prevent push notifications while debug mode is active.
